items.text: Media's Unused filter finds the files nothing uses, and every delete says what it touches before it runs.
The Google basemap keeps its credit and logo in plain sight.
A plate's map hides one feature, or everything a layer held before a day you pick.
A plate's bar stays still on busy days, scrolls its steps with the wheel, and plays hour by hour when you ask.
Right-click a plate's marker that shows a video or a photo to set it on the page, pointing at its place.

pages.title: 3D is here
pages.text: Press 3D on the map and the imagery stands on its relief. Tilt, turn and fly down into any valley.

pages.label: Drawing tools
pages.title: Create your own map!
pages.text: Draw markers, lines and areas with your own icons, every change dated, then send it to My Maps or a KMZ.

pages.title: Maps ready to publish
pages.text: Start from a ready plate, set its look, and export an image, a PDF or a video of its days.

pages.label: View · Overlay · Find
pages.title: Horizon
pages.text: Stand on any point and see its skyline. Find ranks the places whose relief fits a photo's skyline.

pages.title: And also

items.text: Measure turns a line into range rings, a view cone or a line of sight.
Reference windows fade and play clips over the map.
Media opens in one full-screen viewer.

pages.help: The guide now shows every tool in pictures, and walks three tasks step by step.
